title: Java Developer
description: Comprehensive directed learning roadmap for mastering Java from core foundations to enterprise Spring Boot microservices.

nodes.title: Foundations of Java
nodes.description: Core Java environment setup, compilation mechanics, syntax fundamentals, and basic programming constructs.

children.title: Introduction to Java & JVM
children.description: Understanding JDK, JRE, JVM architecture, bytecode execution, and platform independence.

children.title: Setting up Java & IDE (IntelliJ/Eclipse)
children.description: Installing JDK 21+, configuring environment variables (JAVA_HOME), and setting up modern IDEs.

children.title: Basic Syntax: Variables, Data Types, Operators
children.description: Primitive types, type casting, arithmetic, relational, and bitwise operators.

children.title: Input & Output in Java
children.description: Reading input with Scanner, BufferedReader, System.out formatting, and PrintStream.

children.title: Control Flow: if-else, switch, loops
children.description: Conditional branching, enhanced switch expressions, for, while, and do-while loops.

children.title: Methods & Parameters
children.description: Defining static and instance methods, pass-by-value semantics, and varargs.

children.title: Recursion Basics
children.description: Base cases, call stack unwinding, and classic recursive algorithmic thinking.

nodes.title: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP)
nodes.description: Mastering object-oriented software design paradigms, encapsulation, polymorphism, inheritance, and abstraction.

children.title: Classes & Objects
children.description: Blueprint vs instance instantiation, heap allocation, fields, and behavior.

children.title: Constructors & Overloading
children.description: Default, parameterized, copy constructors, constructor chaining (this(), super()), and overloading.

children.title: Encapsulation
children.description: Data hiding, access modifiers (private, protected, public, package-private), getters and setters.

children.title: Inheritance & Method Overriding
children.description: IS-A relationships, extends keyword, @Override annotation, and method signature matching.

children.title: Polymorphism (Compile-time & Runtime)
children.description: Static binding vs dynamic method dispatch, upcasting, downcasting, and instance-of checks.

children.title: Abstraction (Abstract Classes & Interfaces)
children.description: Defining contracts with interfaces, default/static interface methods, sealed classes, and abstract bases.

children.title: Static & Final Keywords
children.description: Static context, memory optimization, final variables, methods, classes, and immutability.

children.title: Inner Classes
children.description: Member inner classes, static nested classes, local inner classes, and anonymous inner classes.

nodes.title: Core Java Concepts
nodes.description: Memory allocation models, immutable string manipulation, wrapper primitives, and annotation systems.

children.title: Strings & StringBuilder
children.description: String constant pool, immutability, String vs StringBuilder vs StringBuffer performance benchmarks.

children.title: Arrays & Multidimensional Arrays
children.description: Contiguous memory layout, array iteration, Arrays utility class, matrix operations.

children.title: Wrapper Classes & Autoboxing
children.description: Primitive wrappers (Integer, Double), autoboxing/unboxing pitfalls, and value caching.

children.title: Packages & Access Modifiers
children.description: Organizing code with package declarations, namespace resolution, and accessibility scopes.

children.title: Enums
children.description: Type-safe enumerations, enum constructors, fields, methods, and EnumSet/EnumMap usage.

children.title: Annotations
children.description: Built-in annotations (@Override, @Deprecated), target & retention policies, custom reflection annotations.

children.title: Java Memory Model (Stack vs Heap)
children.description: Stack frame activation, heap object lifecycle, Garbage Collection (G1, ZGC) algorithms.

nodes.title: Collections Framework
nodes.description: In-depth algorithms, complexity, and internal data structure implementations of java.util Collections.

children.title: Introduction to Collections
children.description: Hierarchy of Collection framework, Iterable interface, Collections class utility helper methods.

children.title: List, ArrayList, LinkedList
children.description: Dynamic array resizing algorithms vs doubly linked list nodes, performance trade-offs.

children.title: Set, HashSet, TreeSet, LinkedHashSet
children.description: Uniqueness contracts, hashCode() & equals() overrides, bucket collisions, and Red-Black tree backings.

children.title: Map, HashMap, TreeMap, LinkedHashMap
children.description: Key-value hashing, load factor, table capacity expansion, concurrent modification checks.

children.title: Queue & Deque
children.description: FIFO queues, PriorityQueue min-heap implementation, ArrayDeque double-ended operations.

children.title: Iterators & Iterable
children.description: Iterator pattern, ListIterator, fail-fast vs fail-safe iterator mechanics.

children.title: Comparable vs Comparator
children.description: Natural ordering via Comparable (compareTo) vs custom sorting strategies with Comparator functional lambdas.

nodes.title: Advanced Java Concepts
nodes.description: Generics type safety, concurrent multithreading execution models, stream API functional pipelines, modern Java updates.

children.title: Generics
children.description: Type parameters, bounded wildcards (? extends T, ? super T), type erasure mechanics.

children.title: Exception Handling
children.description: Checked vs unchecked exceptions, try-catch-finally, try-with-resources, custom exception hierarchies.

children.title: File Handling (I/O Streams, NIO)
children.description: Byte & character streams, Java NIO (Path, Files, Channels, Buffers), non-blocking I/O.

children.title: Serialization & Deserialization
children.description: Serializable interface, serialVersionUID, transient fields, externalizable customization.

children.title: Multithreading & Concurrency
children.description: Thread lifecycles, Runnable, Callable, Executors, synchronized blocks, locks, Volatile, Atomic variables.

children.title: Java 8 Features (Streams, Lambdas, Optional)
children.description: Functional interfaces, lambda syntax, Stream intermediate/terminal operations, Optional null safety.

children.title: Functional Interfaces
children.description: Predicate, Function, Consumer, Supplier, BiFunction, and method references (::).

children.title: Java 9+ Features (Modules, var, Records, etc.)
children.description: JPMS modularity, var local type inference, record data classes, pattern matching switch expressions.

nodes.title: Java Ecosystem
nodes.description: Industrial tooling, dependency management, unit testing suites, and logging infrastructures.

children.title: Java Development Tools (Maven, Gradle)
children.description: POM.xml configuration, build lifecycle phases, dependency resolution, Gradle task scripts.

children.title: Logging Frameworks (Log4j, SLF4J)
children.description: Logging abstraction layers, log levels (DEBUG, INFO, ERROR), appenders, and structured JSON logs.

children.title: JUnit & Testing Frameworks
children.description: Unit testing with JUnit 5, assertions, parameterized tests, Mockito mocking framework.

children.title: Build & Dependency Management
children.description: Multi-module builds, transitive dependencies, plugin management, and repository mirrors.

nodes.title: Databases & Persistence
nodes.description: Relational database connection mechanisms, SQL integration, connection pooling, ORM mapping.

children.title: JDBC Basics
children.description: DriverManager, Connection, Statement, PreparedStatement SQL injection safety, ResultSet handling.

children.title: CRUD Operations with JDBC
children.description: Executing SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE queries, transaction management (commit/rollback).

children.title: Connection Pooling
children.description: HikariCP configuration, connection pool lifecycle, maxLifetime and idle timeout tuning.

children.title: Introduction to JPA & Hibernate
children.description: Java Persistence API entity mappings (@Entity, @Table, @Id), SessionFactory, EntityManager persistence context.

children.title: Mapping Entities & Relationships
children.description: @OneToOne, @OneToMany, @ManyToOne, @ManyToMany annotations, fetch strategies (LAZY vs EAGER).

nodes.title: Frameworks & Web Development
nodes.description: Enterprise Spring Boot framework architecture, RESTful web services, Dependency Injection, Security.

children.title: Java Servlets & JSP
children.description: HttpServlet lifecycle (init, service, destroy), request/response headers, session management.

children.title: Spring Core & Dependency Injection
children.description: Inversion of Control (IoC) container, ApplicationContext, @Component, @Autowired, @Bean lifecycle.

children.title: Spring Boot Basics
children.description: Auto-configuration, Spring Boot starters, application.properties/yml, embedded Tomcat server.

children.title: REST API Development with Spring Boot
children.description: @RestController, @GetMapping, @PostMapping, ResponseEntity, DTO conversions, RequestValidation.

children.title: Spring Data JPA
children.description: JpaRepository interfaces, custom JPQL/Native queries, derived query methods, pagination & sorting.

children.title: Spring Security
children.description: Authentication vs Authorization, SecurityFilterChain, JWT token generation, password hashing (BCrypt).

nodes.title: System Design & Best Practices
nodes.description: SOLID object design principles, battle-tested GoF design patterns, clean architecture, performance tuning.

children.title: Design Patterns in Java
children.description: Creational (Singleton, Factory, Builder), Structural (Adapter, Decorator), Behavioral (Observer, Strategy).

children.title: SOLID Principles
children.description: Single Responsibility, Open/Closed, Liskov Substitution, Interface Segregation, Dependency Inversion.

children.title: Clean Code Practices
children.description: Meaningful naming, method sizing, refactoring code smells, DRY principle, self-documenting code.

children.title: Error Handling Strategies
children.description: Global @ControllerAdvice, standardized RFC 7807 error responses, resilient fallback strategies.

children.title: Performance Optimization
children.description: Profiling memory with VisualVM/JProfiler, eliminating memory leaks, benchmarking with JMH.

nodes.title: Project Building
nodes.description: Hands-on full lifecycle software engineering projects building real-world enterprise applications.

children.title: Console-based Projects
children.description: Building CLI applications (Student Management System / Library System) with file persistence.

children.title: CRUD App with JDBC
children.description: Building a raw Java JDBC application with database connection pools and SQL transactions.

children.title: Spring Boot REST API Project
children.description: Full REST API microservice with OpenAPI Swagger docs, DTO validation, and MySQL persistence.

children.title: Mini E-commerce Application
children.description: E-commerce backend featuring cart checkout, order generation, payment gateway mock, and JPA models.

children.title: Blogging Platform with Spring Boot + Hibernate
children.description: Full-stack blog portal with JWT auth, role management, comment trees, and post tagging.

children.description: Comprehensive review of JVM internals, memory model, immutability, and classloaders.

children.title: Multithreading & Concurrency Q&A
children.description: Solving deadlock scenarios, race conditions, producer-consumer pattern implementation.

children.title: Collections Framework Q&A
children.description: Deep dive into HashMap internals, custom key hashing traps, and tree rebalancing.

children.title: System Design Q&A
children.description: Designing scalable URL shortener, rate limiter, and notification service in Java.

children.title: DSA in Java (LeetCode/AlgoMaster)
children.description: Solving top 100 interview problems using Java collections and optimized data structures.

children.title: Mock Interviews & Coding Challenges
children.description: Timed coding assessments, whiteboarding exercises, and behavioral STAR prep.
